name: Hisahiro
source:
He's the protagonist of the game, a young man living on his own in an apartment. He often has sexual fantasies about his next door neighbors: Keiko and Marika, who unfortunately, are both married. He's an eroge writer, but lately his work has got even duller than usual.
Maybe it's because he is still a virgin?...
